findings.summary: Retained deployment observation bypasses acknowledgement identity and chronology checks.
findings.reproduction: Exact positive control and three negatives all return verified_success without observing: foreign observation deployment ID versus valid acknowledgement; observation predating acknowledgement; missing acknowledgement.
findings.repair: Before accepting deployment definitive_success, require exact attempt-bound acknowledgement, same deployment ID and observation time at or after acknowledgement in both fresh and retained completion paths.
